preconditions: Verify real baseline checkpoint, initial pretrained SHA256, dataset policy and train/val membership hashes.
Read actual args.yaml/effective_train_arguments.json and optimizer_effective.json; resolve optimizer/lr/schedule explicitly rather than letting auto choose a different optimizer across arms.
Freeze common batch, effective batch/accumulation, FP32/AMP policy, seeds, pretrained initialization, epochs=40, patience=10, augmentations not under test, and evaluation settings before any run.
Run source-only memory feasibility; if 960 does not fit common batch, lower batch for ALL new arms and rerun the shared control. Never silently lower only the resolution arm.
Confirm all values inherited from the actual baseline. Skip any augmentation candidate already equal to its control value.
Obtain user approval before Phase 07 training; this matrix contains no executable training command.

common_new_block.precision: FP32 as original baseline unless all-arm bridge is separately documented
common_new_block.optimizer_and_lr: inherit actual resolved baseline optimizer and schedule, not unresolved auto

arms.interpretation: Fresh controlled block, not an attribution comparison with the old batch-8 run; batch-4 bridge and actual optimizer equivalence must be documented.

arms.hypothesis: More network pixels per small source GT may improve localization/recall. Upsampling 640x512 adds no new sensor information. Train/val/inference resolution policy changes together, so claim system-resolution effect, not isolated training benefit.
arms.cost_note: Pixel count is approximately 2.25 times 640; measure actual memory/latency.

arms.hypothesis: If actual baseline scale is 0.5, limiting random shrinking may preserve very small source targets; reduced scale diversity may hurt. This is not selected from WiSARD scores.
Removing mosaic may avoid shrinking sparse source persons; background diversity/regularization may worsen. Only consider if actual control mosaic is enabled.

repeats.rule: Repeat shortlisted source-only arms and matched control with paired seeds; report all seed results, mean/std, do not choose the best seed.

checkpoint_rule: Each run selects best checkpoint using its source validation fitness only; keep all arms and failed/OOM runs in the register.
combination_rule: Do not combine resolution and augmentation changes in the first block. Any later interaction arm requires a new predeclared comparison.
external_rule: WiSARD has already been inspected and is diagnostic development evidence. Final generalization needs new independent missions/flights/sites and verified negative scenes, frozen until model/protocol selection is complete.
